332:     def _call(self, method, *args):
333:         manager = self._manager
334:         with manager._lock:
335:             self._require_live()
336:             if self._active:
337:                 raise SnapshotBusy("Owned worker operations must be serial")
338:             self._active += 1
339:         try:
340:             # Fixed methods only; callers cannot select an arbitrary method.
341:             result = method(self._worker, *args)
342:             with manager._lock:
343:                 self._require_live()
344:             return result
345:         except BaseException as exc:
346:             if not isinstance(exc, Exception):
347:                 with manager._lock:
348:                     manager._quarantine_preserving(self._record, "Owned operation interrupted", exc)
349:             raise
350:         finally:
351:             with manager._lock:
352:                 self._active -= 1
